title: Policy exemptions review
description: Audits policy exemptions to find expired ones and those without proper justification that may be covering non-compliance.
example_prompt: "List all policy exemptions across subscriptions. Show: exemption name, scope, exempted policy, category (waiver/mitigated), expiration date, and description. Flag: (1) exemptions past their expiration date, (2) exemptions without an expiration date, (3) exemptions with no description/justification."
